name: post.sync
description: Keeps one brand's Instagram or Facebook posts and stories as Make read them back (docs/executing/posted-page-plan.md): a batch of up to 50 readings for the account the brand has linked through Make. A post Brand Base sent is found by its live job's id there (for a Facebook video or reel, the video id) and gets only its counts, its first account's, and its address if it had none: its caption and media stay. A post made outside Brand Base, or one imported from the same Instagram address, is a posted post of its own, its caption refreshed by a newer reading. Two readings of one post in a batch: the newer is kept. Each reading with counts or an address is kept beside the post, with that address, so a post on two accounts has each one's link and counts; counts the platform did not give are left out, never 0, and an older reading never replaces a newer one, so the same batch twice changes nothing. A story ends 24 hours after it went out unless the reading says when. Answers the posts made and updated, the readings kept, and the posts that still need a cover. Called by the server's Make route, never by a screen or an agent's tool.
sql:
with b as (select id, timezone from brandbase.brands where id = :brand),
raw as (
  select distinct on (e ->> 'externalId') e ->> 'externalId' as ext, e ->> 'kind' as kind,
    (e ->> 'postedAt')::timestamptz as posted_at, coalesce(e ->> 'caption', '') as caption,
    nullif(e ->> 'permalink', '') as permalink, jsonb_strip_nulls(coalesce(e -> 'metrics', '{}')) as metrics,
    (e ->> 'readAt')::timestamptz as read_at,
    case when e ->> 'kind' = 'story' then coalesce((e ->> 'expiresAt')::timestamptz, (e ->> 'postedAt')::timestamptz + interval '24 hours') end as expires_at
  from jsonb_array_elements(:items::jsonb) e
  order by e ->> 'externalId', (e ->> 'readAt')::timestamptz desc
),
found as (
  select r.*, s.post_id as sent_post, coalesce(s.post_id, i.id, :brand || '-' || :channel || '-' || r.ext) as post_id
  from raw r
  left join lateral (select j.post_id from brandbase.post_jobs j where j.brand_id = :brand and j.channel = :channel
    and j.status = 'live' and j.external_id = r.ext order by j.post_id limit 1) s on true
  left join lateral (select p.id from brandbase.posts p where s.post_id is null and :channel = 'ig' and p.brand_id = :brand
    and brandbase.ig_shortcode(p.permalink) = brandbase.ig_shortcode(r.permalink)
    and not exists (select 1 from brandbase.post_jobs j where j.post_id = p.id)
    order by p.id = :brand || '-ig-' || r.ext desc, p.id limit 1) i on true
),
one as (
  select distinct on (f.post_id) f.* from found f order by f.post_id, f.read_at desc, f.ext
),
m as (
  select f.*, o.media as was_media,
    f.sent_post is null and (o.id is null or (o.brand_id = :brand and o.marked = 'posted'
      and not exists (select 1 from brandbase.post_jobs j where j.post_id = o.id))) as own
  from one f left join brandbase.posts o on o.id = f.post_id
),
sent_up as (
  update brandbase.posts p set metrics = m.metrics, measured_at = m.read_at, permalink = coalesce(p.permalink, m.permalink)
  from m
  where m.sent_post is not null and p.id = m.sent_post and p.brand_id = :brand and m.metrics <> '{}'::jsonb
    and m.read_at > coalesce(p.measured_at, '-infinity')
    and :channel = (select u.c from unnest(p.channels) with ordinality u (c, n)
      where exists (select 1 from brandbase.post_jobs j where j.post_id = p.id and j.channel = u.c and j.status = 'live')
      order by u.n limit 1)
  returning p.id
),
own_up as (
  insert into brandbase.posts as x (id, brand_id, format, hook, day, time, caption, channels, media, marked, permalink,
    metrics, measured_at, expires_at, synced_at)
  select m.post_id, :brand, case m.kind when 'reel' then 'reel' when 'story' then 'story' else 'carousel' end,
    coalesce((select left(btrim(l.t), 120) from regexp_split_to_table(m.caption, chr(10)) with ordinality l (t, n)
      where l.t ~ '[[:alnum:]]' order by l.n limit 1),
      case :channel when 'ig' then 'Instagram ' else 'Facebook ' end || case m.kind when 'reel' then 'reel' when 'story' then 'story' else 'post' end),
    (m.posted_at at time zone b.timezone)::date, to_char(m.posted_at at time zone b.timezone, 'HH24:MI'),
    m.caption, array[:channel::text], '[]'::jsonb, 'posted', m.permalink,
    nullif(m.metrics, '{}'::jsonb), case when m.metrics <> '{}'::jsonb then m.read_at end, m.expires_at, m.read_at
  from m cross join b
  where m.own
  on conflict (id) do update set
    caption = case when excluded.synced_at > coalesce(x.synced_at, '-infinity') then excluded.caption else x.caption end,
    permalink = case when excluded.synced_at > coalesce(x.synced_at, '-infinity') then coalesce(excluded.permalink, x.permalink) else x.permalink end,
    expires_at = case when excluded.synced_at > coalesce(x.synced_at, '-infinity') then coalesce(excluded.expires_at, x.expires_at) else x.expires_at end,
    metrics = case when excluded.measured_at > coalesce(x.measured_at, '-infinity') then excluded.metrics else x.metrics end,
    measured_at = greatest(x.measured_at, excluded.measured_at),
    synced_at = greatest(x.synced_at, excluded.synced_at)
  where x.brand_id = excluded.brand_id and x.marked = 'posted'
    and not exists (select 1 from brandbase.post_jobs j where j.post_id = x.id)
    and (excluded.synced_at > coalesce(x.synced_at, '-infinity') or excluded.measured_at > coalesce(x.measured_at, '-infinity'))
  returning x.id, x.xmax = 0 as made
),
readings as (
  insert into brandbase.post_readings (brand_id, channel, external_id, read_at, post_id, metrics, permalink)
  select :brand, :channel, m.ext, m.read_at, m.post_id, m.metrics, m.permalink from m
  where (m.metrics <> '{}'::jsonb or m.permalink is not null) and (m.sent_post is not null or m.own)
  on conflict do nothing
  returning 1
)
select jsonb_build_object('brand', :brand, 'channel', :channel,
  'made', (select count(*) from own_up where made),
  'updated', (select count(*) from own_up where not made) + (select count(*) from sent_up),
  'readings', (select count(*) from readings),
  'covers', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('externalId', m.ext, 'post', m.post_id) order by m.ext)
    from m where m.own and coalesce(m.was_media, '[]'::jsonb) = '[]'::jsonb), '[]'::jsonb)) as result
from b
